output.summary: A genus of palm-like trees and shrubs native to the Old World tropics and subtropics. Many have crowns of strap-shaped leaves and thick stilt roots supporting their top-heavy growth; their fruits comprise pineapple-like sections that typically turn orange or red when ripe.
output.edibilityNote: Some species provide food; ripe large- and medium-fruited forms are eaten raw or cooked, while partly ripe fruit should be cooked.
